# Objections to sales

| Problem | Answer! |
| --- | --- |
| **What are the advantages of AI applications?** | Visualized components and process configurations can reduce the threshold for partial applications and support faster iterativeization; the scope of application depends on the complexity of operations, interfaces, competencies, performance and maintenance requirements, with complex scenarios still to be professionally developed and tested. |
| ** Where are the unique advantages and reliability of KuailuAI applications compared to mature competitions? ** | Product comparisons should be made at the same time, in the same version, in the manner of deployment and in the scale of use, by comparison of functionality, system integration, security of authority, delivery of services and overall cost; and should not be qualified as lacking evidence of the same condition. |
| ** Distinction from mainstream ERP and financial systems** | Product comparisons should be made at the same time, in the same version, in the manner of deployment and in the scale of use, by comparison of functionality, system integration, security of authority, delivery of services and overall cost; and should not be qualified as lacking evidence of the same condition. |
| ** Discrepancies with mainstream business office platforms and advantages** | Product comparisons should be made at the same time, in the same version, in the manner of deployment and in the scale of use, by comparison of functionality, system integration, security of authority, delivery of services and overall cost; and should not be qualified as lacking evidence of the same condition. |
| ** What happens when existing modules cannot meet individualized needs?** | Visibility configurations can be assessed for needs; the scope, cost, periodicity and acceptance criteria for customized development can be confirmed when complex business logic, interface or data structure is involved. |
| ** What are the advantages of Kuailu compared to other software companies?** | Product comparisons should be made at the same time, in the same version, in the manner of deployment and in the scale of use, by comparison of functionality, system integration, security of authority, delivery of services and overall cost; and should not be qualified as lacking evidence of the same condition. |
| ** What is the assessment of Kuailu Meeting ' s differential capacity?** | At the same time, at the same time, in version, deployment mode, network conditions and scale, comparing audio and video, AI minutes, multilingualism, conference management, secure deployment, compatibility, service and overall cost; the specific capabilities are based on product information. |
| ** What are the advantages of Kuailu Meeting over the mainstream videoconferencing platform? ** | Product comparisons should be done at the same time, in the same version, in the manner of deployment and in the size of use, by comparison of functionality, system integration, authority security, service delivery and overall cost. The reference capabilities for Kuailu products are based on the corresponding product profiles, functional modules and deployment instructions. |
